text:
MIN arrives at Calgary after a 4-3 overtime loss at EDM, where Evan Bouchard ended it. The Wild are 3-1-1 in their last five and are without Marcus Foligno and Nick Foligno. CGY, off four days of rest, snapped Carolina's seven-game winning streak with a 3-2 win but have been outscored 21-14 over their last five and are missing Mikael Backlund and Samuel Honzek. Quinn Hughes is two points from 500 career points, Blake Coleman is back in Calgary for the first time since leaving the Flames, and Jake Middleton faces the Wild for the first time since leaving them.

At five on five, MIN has taken 53% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) in its games, CGY 48%. The Flames are better than their record, with finishing and goaltending costing them. They also take 4.8 penalties a game, which keeps handing opponents power plays. Joel Farabee is next in line for Backlund's minutes.

In net, projected starter Jesper Wallstedt (MIN) is at +6.9 goals saved above expected, meaning goals prevented compared with an average goalie facing the same shots. Projected starter Devin Cooley (CGY), in for Dustin Wolf, is at -2.6 this season, though he was +17.2 last year. Kirill Kaprizov has a 7-game point streak and is 80% for a point tonight, Hughes 74%. Our under-the-radar pick is Joel Eriksson Ek (MIN), 59% for a point, above what his season pace suggests, because his line creates chances.
